notes.title: Square Wars Update v0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]🌸Welcome Spring 20% Discount🎉[/h1]  

[h3]🆕 New Additions[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] 🏭 [b]Square Factory[/b] card/building has been added! Now there's another option for gaining squares. You can build it by playing the card or capture it from the enemy!  
[*] 🃏 Cards can now be dragged directly from the market to the game board! Things just got much easier; you can quickly use cards you don’t want to keep in your hand.  
[*] 🖥️ [b]Resolutions[/b] option has been added to the settings panel! Improvements have been made for 16:10 screens in addition to 16:9. The game now looks much better on most screens and Steam Deck!  
[*] 🏪 Steam store visuals and logo have been updated! How does it look? Cool, right? 😎  
[*] 🎨 The menu background image has been refreshed! More modern, more stylish!  
[*] 🖱️ Camera panning with the mouse has been added in-game! You can easily navigate the map with [b](RMB & Mouse3)[/b].  
[/list]  
[h3]⚙️ Improvements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] 🎲 Card drop rates have been improved based on conditions! Cards will still appear based on the [b]chance[/b] stat, but the market now displays smarter and more functional cards. [i]For example, if there are no bridges in the game, the chance of getting a [b]Destroy Bridge[/b] card is significantly lower.[/i]  
[*] 🎴 The first cards at the start of the game no longer have stats. This will reduce early-game disadvantages!  
[*] 🏦 The [b]Trade Market[/b] card has been renamed to [b]Trade Center[/b]! Sounds cooler, right?  
[*] 🤖 AI’s decision-making for playing cards and constructing buildings has been improved! The AI now makes smarter choices.  
[*] 🎶 The overall game feel has been enhanced with various animations and sound effects! In online games, you will better understand your opponent’s moves.  
[*] ✨ Outline effects on some objects have been improved for a sharper and more aesthetic look.  
[/list]  
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] 🔧 Fixed a bug that occurred when clicking the same square simultaneously in online games.  
[*] 📺 Fixed UI stretching issues on 16:10 screens and Steam Deck.  
[*] 🌾 Fixed an issue where the AI had problems constructing the [b]Windmill[/b].  
[*] 🏆 Fixed the "Day 1 Victory!" bug occurring at the start of the game.  
[/list]  
And many more improvements that I couldn’t fit here!  

💬 Please stay tuned and join our [b]Discord channel[/b]! Square Wars is shaped by your support and ideas. Looking forward to seeing you in upcoming updates! 🚀  

🖊️ Gökhan Birçek

notes.title: v0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What’s New in Version 0.3.1?[/h1]

[h2]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Local Co-op Mode![/h2]
Although local co-op is still in an early stage, this version allows two players to join a local or online game using the same device. And there’s much more to come!

[h3]How Does Local Co-op Work?[/h3]

Both players must work together as one, fighting for the same team. True cooperation is essential.
[list]
[*] [b]Player 1:[/b] One player manages the market, trade (economy), and card strategies. ([i]It is recommended for this player to use a mouse.[/i])
[*] [b]Player 2:[/b] The other player can use either a keyboard or a controller to focus on territory expansion, resource gathering, and battle strategies.
[/list]
[h3]What’s Planned for Local Co-op in the Future?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many more features will be added to enhance local co-op.
[*] Two different teams will be playable on the same device.
[*] The UI will be updated accordingly.
[*] Full controller support will be implemented.[/list]
[h3]Other Additions, Improvements, and Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller/Gamepad support added. (Not fully supported yet, but local co-op is playable.)
[*] "Remote Play Together" added. Even if your friend isn’t physically with you, you can still experience local co-op through this feature.
[*] Three different map sizes added.
[*] The issue of starting the game surrounded by mountains or seas has been removed. The starting phase is now more open and free.
[*] AI opponents have been improved. They now start more spread out across the map. (Difficulty has slightly increased and will continue to be balanced.)
[*] Issues related to volcanic eruptions have been fixed.
[*] The "Shortcuts" panel has been updated and is now called "Controls."
[/list]

*Edit: A major problem at the beginning of the online game has been fixed with v0.3.1. Please make sure your version is up to date for the best experience.

Join our Discord! Your suggestions and feedback are incredibly valuable. See you soon!

Gökhan,
Best regards

notes.title: Square Wars is Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Square Wars is Coming to Early Access on January 10, 2025, at GMT+3![/h2]
Add the game to your library now to support its development and take advantage of the special early price.

[h2]Online Multiplayer: Challenge Your Friends![/h2]
Square Wars now features an Online Multiplayer mode to play with your friends. Plan your strategy, lead your team, and challenge your friends to claim victory!

[h2]Single Player: A Brand-New Experience Awaits![/h2]
If you've played the demo version, you'll see just how much has changed! Here's what's new:  
[list]
[*] A sleeker and more modern interface  
[*] Brand-new cards and designs  
[*] Dozens of new gameplay mechanics  
[*] Improved gameplay dynamics  
[*] A more stable gaming experience[/list]

[h2]Support for 12 New Languages[/h2]
[h3]All Supported Languages[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]English[/b]  
[*] Turkish
[*] French  
[*] German  
[*] Castilian Spanish  
[*] Simplified Chinese  
[*] Dutch  
[*] Japanese  
[*] Polish  
[*] Hungarian  
[*] Russian  
[*] Swedish[/list]

[h2][b]Bonus:[/b] Play on the Platform You Prefer![/h2]
Square Wars works seamlessly on both Windows and Mac devices. Whichever platform you choose, you’ll have an incredible experience!  

We'll be back soon with more updates and surprises about the game. Thank you for your support.

Best regards,  
Gökhan Birçek
